events.name: Bash
events.head: Check guarantee seal in code, probe, and pass.py fields
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -n -i "guarantee\|seal" app/scripts/probe-keyart.mjs | head; grep -rn -i "guarantee\|GuaranteeSeal\|seal" app/src/app/vip app/src/components/masterclass --include=*.tsx | head; grep -n -i "what you keep" -r app/src --include=*.ts* | head -5; grep -n "spec\|def cmd_set\|allowed" workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py | head -20

events.name: Bash
events.head: Locate guarantee art in source; view probe header
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -rn -i "key-guarantee\|guarantee" app/src | head; echo ---; grep -rln -i "what you keep" app/src | head; echo ---; sed -n 1,60p app/scripts/probe-keyart.mjs; grep -n "def \|\"spec\"\|'spec'" workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py | head -40

events.name: Bash
events.head: Narrow search for guarantee seal source
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -rln -i "key-guarantee\|guarantee" app/src --exclude-dir=generated | head; echo ---; grep -rn -i "key-guarantee" app/src --exclude-dir=generated | cut -c1-200 | head; echo ---; grep -rln -i "what you keep" app/src --exclude-dir=generated | head; echo; sed -n 20,45p app/scripts/probe-keyart.mjs; ls app/public/img/vip | grep -i guar

events.name: Bash
events.head: View seal block and compare with origin/main
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; sed -n 370,430p app/src/components/masterclass/vip-stack.tsx; echo ---; git fetch -q origin 2>/dev/null; git show origin/main:app/src/components/masterclass/vip-stack.tsx | grep -n -i "guarantee\|what you keep" ; echo ---; grep -n -i "guarantee\|refund" app/src/app/vip/vip-client.tsx | cut -c1-200

events.text: Checked: on /vip the shield image now sits on a "What you keep" block with no refund promise. Next I'll update the spec, probe label and evidence to match.

events.name: Bash

events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -n "def cmd_set" -A40 workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py | grep -n -i "spec\|evidence\|kv\[" | head; sed -n 1,14p app/src/components/masterclass/vip-stack.tsx

events.text: Now edit the probe label and the stale component comment.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Relabel probe check and fix stale comment

events.text: Now verify against the live mirror (/vip only) and grep its text for refund language.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run key-art probe on /vip and grep refund copy
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; ONLY=vip V=$(date +%s) timeout 180 node scripts/probe-keyart.mjs 2>&1 | tail -8; curl -s "https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/vip/?v=$(date +%s)" | sed 's/<[^>]*>/ /g' | grep -o -i "refund[^.]\{0,40\}\|money-back\|risk-free\|guarantee[^.]\{0,30\}\|What you keep" | sort | uniq -c | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run probe on /vip and show guarantee sentence context
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; ONLY=vip V=$(date +%s) node scripts/probe-keyart.mjs 2>&1 | tail -8; curl -s "https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/vip/?v=$(date +%s)" | sed 's/<[^>]*>/ /g' | grep -o -i ".\{80\}guarantee of your own results.\{40\}" | head -2
